sources.entry: Tuleap - Tuleap is a libre suite to plan, track, code and collaborate on software projects. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: Tuleap
summary.one_liner: Tuleap is an open-source ALM platform for planning, tracking, coding and collaborating on software projects, with agile and compliance tooling.
summary.what_it_does: Tuleap combines requirements, development, testing and documentation in a single platform. It supports hybrid agile frameworks including SAFe, Scrum, Kanban and V-model, and offers backlog and roadmap synchronization. It provides requirements traceability from requirement to test, centralized test plans, and approval and validation workflows aimed at ISO and ASPICE audit readiness. It includes fine-grained access control by project and user role and an integrated Git and CI/CD setup. The page says it can be deployed in the cloud or on-premises, and the core is described as auditable open source.
notable: Hybrid agile support (SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, V-model) in one tool
Requirements-to-test traceability aimed at ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and ASPICE compliance
Cloud, on-premises or air-gapped deployment with data hosted in France or on-site
Published by Enalean, a European software company
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing for hosted or support tiers
Page does not describe installation requirements or system specs
